name: curie
tagline: Deploy Claude Code agent bundles to production
description: curie is a tool for taking a Claude Code agent bundle and deploying it to production. It organizes agents into three tiers — skill, local, and cluster — and treats a git push as the deploy action, with a parity ladder evaluation to check that the deployed agent behaves like its local version. That makes it a practical bridge between building an agent in Claude Code and running it as a persistent service on your own infrastructure.
highlights: Deploys Claude Code agent bundles to production
Three tiers: skill, local, and cluster
Git push as the deploy trigger
Parity ladder evaluation checks deployed behavior
curatorNote: Most agent tooling stops at the local session. Treating a git push as a deploy and verifying behavior parity is a genuinely useful step toward running agents as durable infrastructure.
